title: 第11章  培育御兽云绒狐第12章  顺手抢的天材地宝
slug: 御兽我契约的皆可返祖
content_zh:
“稀有的培育材料？”
夜离殇用有些惊讶的目光看着龙疏寒。
而龙疏寒只是淡淡一笑，并没有说话。
很快，吃完御兽口粮的云绒狐，用小爪子扒拉着夜离殇的小腿，口中发出撒娇一般的呜嘤声。
听着云绒狐的声音，夜离殇嘴角微微上扬，将手中的冰绒草递到它的嘴边。
呜嘤～
云绒狐叫了一声，一口咬住冰绒草，津津有味地咀嚼起来。
不一会，吃完冰绒草的云绒狐，轻轻吐出一口带着寒气的白雾，随后抬起头，用水汪汪的眸子看着面前的夜离殇。
夜离殇伸手将云绒狐抱起来，打开两瓶月魄凝露喂给云绒狐。
冰绒草可以增强云绒狐冰属性的能力。
而月魄凝露则是可以提升云绒狐的成长速度。
看着云绒狐将两瓶月魄凝露都喝完后，夜离殇将云绒狐放在地上，把那盒打开的御兽口粮放在它的面前。
“雪球，你可以敞开了吃哦。”
“吃完咱们再去买。”
夜离殇伸手在云绒狐的小脑袋上揉了揉。
呜嘤，呜嘤～
云绒狐点点小脑袋，看着夜离殇的眼神亮晶晶的。
“噗嗤～”
“跟着我，我肯定不会亏待你的啦。”
夜离殇轻笑一声，在沙发上坐了下来，静静地看着云绒狐吃东西。

云绒狐坐在地上，用小爪子捧着御兽口粮，吃得津津有味。
“离殇，梦璃曾经教过你提升精神力的办法，和一些基本的战斗技巧吗？”
龙疏寒将目光看向夜离殇，突然问道。
“嗯，学过一点点基础的。”
夜离殇整理一下耳边的秀发，轻声回答着。
“嗯，那我明天也教你一些东西，顺便帮你训练一下这只小狐狸。”
龙疏寒打了个哈欠，从沙发上起身，往房间的方向走去，一边走，一边说道：“我先回房间休息一会，晚饭的时候，你不用叫我的，自己吃就行了。”
“好的，龙阿姨。”
夜离殇答应一声后，就目送着龙疏寒离开。
咔哒一声。
房门关上，夜离殇收回视线，将目光重新放在云绒狐的身上，只见此时的云绒狐正满足地坐在地上，用小爪子抚摸着自己的小肚子。
“雪球，过来。”
夜离殇向着云绒狐勾了勾手指。
看着夜离殇的动作，云绒狐一个跳跃，身体轻盈地落入夜离殇怀中，用小脑袋在夜离殇的怀中轻蹭着。
“雪球，我们也要开始训练了哦。”
“你的天赋能力还没有使用过呢，你先尝试着使用一下，起码也要能熟练掌握才行。”
夜离殇的眼神很是认真。
呜嘤~
云绒狐叫了一声，眼神自信满满。
熟练掌握而已，在它看来就是洒洒水的事情。

毕竟，它昨天变大的时候，那是轻而易举的碾压了三只御兽的，而那股堪称无敌般的力量，也让它记忆深刻。
云绒狐从夜离殇的怀中跳下来，平稳落在地上，淡淡的冰蓝色光芒在它的脚下绽放，身影犹如离弦之箭一般冲了出去，在客厅中留下一道道的残影。
content_en:
"Rare cultivation materials?"
Ye Lishang looked at Long Shuhan with somewhat surprised eyes.
Long Shuhan just smiled faintly and did not speak.
Soon, the Yunrong Fox, who had finished eating the animal rations, used its small paws to pull Ye Lishang's calf, and made a coquettish whine from its mouth.
Listening to the voice of the Cloud Velvet Fox, Ye Lishang raised the corners of his mouth slightly and handed the Ice Velvet Grass in his hand to its mouth.
Woohoo~
The Cloud Velvet Fox barked, bit into the Ice Velvet Grass, and chewed it with relish.
After a while, Yun Ronghu, who had finished eating the ice velvet grass, gently exhaled a mouthful of cold white mist, then raised his head and looked at Ye Lishang in front of him with watery eyes.
Ye Li Shang reached out to pick up Yun Ronghu, opened two bottles of Moon Soul Gel and fed them to Yun Ronghu.
Ice velvet grass can enhance the ice attribute ability of cloud velvet fox.
The Moon Soul Condensation can increase the growth rate of the Cloud Velvet Fox.
After watching Yun Ronghu drink up both bottles of Moon Soul Gel, Ye Lishang placed Yun Ronghu on the ground and placed the open box of beast-taming rations in front of it.
"Snowball, you can open it and eat it."
"Let's go shopping after eating."
Ye Lishang stretched out his hand and rubbed Yunrong Hu's little head.
Woohoo, Woohoo~
Yunrong Hu nodded his little head and looked at Ye Lishang with bright eyes.
"Pfft~"
"Follow me and I won't treat you badly."
Ye Lishang chuckled, sat down on the sofa, and watched Yun Ronghu eating quietly.
Yunrong Fox sat on the ground, holding the animal rations in his little paws, eating with gusto.
"Li Shang, has Mengli ever taught you how to improve your spiritual power and some basic combat skills?"
Long Shuhan looked at Ye Lishang and asked suddenly.
"Yeah, I've learned a little bit about the basics."
Ye Lishang straightened the hair beside his ears and answered softly.
"Well, then I will teach you something tomorrow and help you train this little fox."
Long Shuhan yawned, got up from the sofa, and walked towards the room. As he walked, he said, "I'll go back to the room to rest for a while. You don't need to call me for dinner, just eat it by yourself."
"Okay, Aunt Long."
After Ye Lishang agreed, he watched Long Shuhan leave.
There was a click.
After the door closed, Ye Lishang withdrew his gaze and focused his attention on Yunrong Hu again. He saw that Yunrong Hu was sitting on the ground contentedly, stroking his belly with his little paws.
"Snowball, come here."
Ye Li Shang raised his fingers towards Yun Rong Hu.
Seeing Ye Li Shang's movements, Yun Ronghu jumped up and landed lightly into Ye Li Shang's arms, nuzzling his little head in Ye Li Shang's arms.
"Snowball, we have to start training too."
"You haven't used your innate ability yet. You should try to use it first. At least you must be able to master it proficiently."
Ye Lishang's eyes were very serious.
Woohoo~
Yunrong Hu barked, his eyes full of confidence.
It's just a matter of mastering it. From its perspective, it's just a matter of sprinkling water.
After all, when it grew bigger yesterday, it easily crushed three beasts, and its invincible power also left a deep impression on it.
The Yunrong Fox jumped down from Ye Lishang's arms and landed smoothly on the ground. A faint icy blue light bloomed under its feet, and its figure rushed out like an arrow from a string, leaving afterimages in the living room.
